revision: v2 — per-provider request blocks; launches paced after an observed free-tier 429; request content, case semantics and adapters unchanged
purpose: owner-authorized evaluation-only hosted comparison of the frozen S8.2 v2 workflow suite through the real application boundary; not a product adoption, runtime migration or privacy-safe production claim
authority: owner authorized test API calls for gemma-4-26b-a4b-it and gemini-3.5-flash-lite on Google AI Studio, and for deepseek-v4.1-flash through the OpenCode Go gateway, with synthetic fixture data only
retry_policy: no retry on any 4xx response including 429; at most one retry after a transport timeout or a 5xx response, recorded as attempt 2. A rate-limited case stays a recorded provider error in that pass, and a further complete pass is a separately labelled independent run rather than a retry inside one.
conversation: one user turn, no tool results, no multi-turn follow-up: the same single-turn contract the local profiles were measured under

google-ai-studio.authentication: GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_KEY loaded from the repository local .env in-process and sent only as the x-goog-api-key request header
google-ai-studio.pacing_note: The free tier enforces 16000 generate-content input tokens per minute for gemma-4-26b. An early unpaced pass hit that documented limit on one case (a 429, preserved as a provider error). Later launches are spaced to stay under it. Pacing changes only launch timing, never request content, the adapter or the per-request latency measurement.

opencode-go.authentication: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY loaded from the repository local .env in-process and sent only as an Authorization: Bearer header, together with a stable x-opencode-session and a client user agent, which OpenCode Go documents as client requirements
opencode-go.protocol_note: OpenCode Go serves DeepSeek models over the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API with OpenAI-style tools/tool_calls. Official Console documentation maps deepseek-v4.1-flash to chat/completions; the Responses API is documented for GPT models. The Go gateway route is https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, distinct from the Console /inference route, whose 402 response is retained only as a wrong-route diagnostic.

notes: temperature/topP/topK/seed mirror the frozen local sampler family where the hosted API exposes the parameter. Google accepts topK; the OpenAI-compatible Go route has no top_k, and neither transport has llama.cpp's repeat penalty.
thinkingLevel minimal keeps the Google single-pass decode comparable to the local profiles; DeepSeek's reasoning channel is reported separately through completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.
maxOutputTokens 2048 is generous relative to the local 768-token cap so an answer is not truncated by transport policy; a length finish is recorded per case.
